name: media-manager
description: Media Manager - Physical media collection management with storage tracking

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:clients"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run generate:clients
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.validate:clients: pnpm run validate:typescript && pnpm run validate:python && pnpm run validate:mock
scripts.validate:python: cd generated/python-client && python -m pip install -e . && python -c 'import media_manager_client; print("Python client validation successful")'
scripts.clean: pnpm run clean:generated && pnpm run clean:build
scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm run setup:frontend && pnpm run setup:tools
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && python -m flake8 app/ && python -m black --check app/
scripts.format: pnpm run format:backend && pnpm run format:frontend

author: trekie86
